Current configuration:

  model:       lightonai/LateOn-Code-edge (default)
  precision:   int8 (build default)
  coreml-cache: (default: ~/Library/Caches/next-plaid/coreml)
  pool-factor: 2 (default)
  parallel:    auto (runtime-resolved)
  batch-size:  auto (runtime-resolved)
  k:           25 (default)
  n:           6 (default)
  verbose:     false (default)
  rel-paths:   true
  hybrid:      true (default)
  alpha:       0.60 (default)
  max-depth:   1024 (default)
  ignore:      .claude/worktrees, **/some-workspace/results
  force-incl:  (none)

Use --k or --n to set values. Use 0 to reset to default.
Use --fp32 or --int8 to change model precision.
Use --pool-factor to set embedding compression (1=disabled, 2+=enabled). Use 0 to reset.
Use --parallel to set number of parallel ONNX sessions. Use 0 to reset to auto (CPU count).
Use --batch-size to set batch size per session. Use 0 to reset to default (1).
Use --max-recursion-depth to set parser recursion guard. Use 0 to reset to default.
Use --verbose or --no-verbose to set default output mode.
Use --relative-paths or --no-relative-paths to toggle relative/absolute paths.
Use --hybrid-search or --no-hybrid-search to toggle FTS5 hybrid search.
Use --alpha to set hybrid search balance (0=keyword, 1=semantic). Use 0 to reset.
Use --ignore/--no-ignore to add/remove extra ignore patterns. --clear-ignore to reset.
Use --force-include/--no-force-include to add/remove force-include patterns. --clear-force-include to reset.
